description: Replace every regular test category with a new set made from the system knowledge and the active prompts, then sort every regular test into it, in the background (Test Lab, Categories, Replace with generated categories). Names and moves made by hand are lost; no test is deleted. Uses an LLM and counts against a daily limit. Returns the background job; follow it with list_jobs. Deleting cannot be undone. Before you call this, look the item up so you know it exists; if it does not, say so and ask nothing. Then tell the user plainly what will be deleted, naming it as the lookup shows it, and ask whether they are sure, in words like: "You asked me to delete <what>. Are you sure you want to proceed?" Then stop and wait. Call it only when the user's next message confirms that exact item. If several items could be meant, list them with their ids and ask which; the user's choice is not a confirmation, so name the chosen item with its id and ask again. If they decline, hesitate, ask something else or change the request, do not delete; ask again before deleting later.
